about: The one shared table of measure-to-measure links (04 SYSTEM SPECS, part 5). Each lane owns the links into its measures. Sizes are calibration anchors from docs/research/outcome-web-2026-09-28.md and are never shown to players; nor are sources. A null size is a link known to be real whose size is not approved yet: it is carried and moves nothing.

points of poverty per point of unemployment
links.note: CONFIRMED by F, awaiting Claude CTO's approval: 0.4 to 0.7 points of official poverty per point (Hoynes, Page and Stevens 2006, JEP); children's pre-transfer poverty about 1.1 points (Bitler, Hoynes and Kuka 2017).

links.unit: elasticity: 10% higher minimum, 3.3% fewer in poverty
links.note: Research range 0.2 to 0.46 (the midpoint here); income gains are about 2/3 after benefit losses, which the range already nets.

links.unit: share less food insecurity per point of participation
links.note: Receiving SNAP cuts food insecurity about 30% and very low food security about 20% for recipients. The place-level size needs recipients' base rate.

links.unit: points of child poverty per $1,000 a child
links.note: The 2021 credit: child poverty 5.2% (2021), 12.4% (2022) after it expired. A per-dollar size is F's to derive and have approved.
